say:2:1035004001:1.text: With the appearance of those black and purple plants, Master Eomir went to visit Rainford, where things are more dire.
say:2:1035004001:1.source_cn: 因为那些紫黑色植物的出现，伊米尔贤者去过情况较为严重的...

choice_prompt:3:1035004001.text: With the appearance of those black and purple plants, Master Eomir went to visit Rainford, where things are more dire.
choice_prompt:3:1035004001.source_cn: 因为那些紫黑色植物的出现，伊米尔贤者去过情况较为严重的沐霖村。

say:4:1035004002:1.text: I don't remember. It's been a while.
say:4:1035004002:1.source_cn: 不记得了，已经有一阵子了。

say:5:1035004003:1.text: Although the village's condition hasn't improved, at least it shows he truly cares about us.
say:5:1035004003:1.source_cn: 虽然那村子的情况没变好，但起码说明大贤者很关心我们。

say:6:1035004004:1.text: But when we called out for him to rest, he ignored us! So rude, even for a sage.
say:6:1035004004:1.source_cn: 可我们喊他来休息，他却没有回应！真是位没礼貌的贤者。

say:7:1035004005:1.text: Mother, perhaps Master Eomir is just getting old, and his hearing isn't as good as it used to be. After all, he's not a Windwhisperer.
say:7:1035004005:1.source_cn: 母亲，贤者伊米尔或许只是上了年纪，耳朵不太好——毕竟他...
